candidate.note: The predicate checks if a permanent has no digivolution cards, which aligns with MatchConditionPermanentCount's ability to evaluate conditions on permanents.

review.reason: 원본은 card.Owner.Enemy(상대) 한정인데 후보 MatchConditionPermanentCount 는 전체 permanent 대상. 스코프 오류.
review.note: Permanent 람다 멤버는 passthrough(Permanent.HasNoDigivolutionCards 실재). 전체 로워링은 GetBattleAreaDigimons().Count 복합 재작성 규칙 필요.
